name: Lyo.Discord.Models
tagline: Wire-level DTOs and shared constants for the Discord integration. `Lyo.Discord.Client` (typed HTTP client) and `Lyo.Discord.Postgres` (API host + persistence) both use these so request and response shapes stay aligned.
description: Wire-level DTOs and shared constants for the Discord integration. Used by [`Lyo.Discord.Client`](../Lyo.Discord.Client/README.md) (typed HTTP client) and [`Lyo.Discord.Postgres`](../Lyo.Discord.Postgres/README.md) (API host + persistence) so request and response shapes stay aligned.

sections.title: Inbound DTOs ([`Request/`](Request))
sections.text: Mutable request DTOs that the API host maps onto its EF entities (CRUD hooks stamp audit timestamps, not clients). One per Discord domain entity: `DiscordUserReq`, `DiscordGuildReq`, `DiscordChannelReq`, `DiscordEmojiReq`, `DiscordRoleReq`, `DiscordInteractionReq`, `DiscordMessageReq`, `DiscordAttachmentReq`, `DiscordMemberReq`.

sections.title: Outbound DTOs ([`Response/`](Response))
sections.text: Sealed `record`s for read shapes (usually a subset of entity columns, omitting audit timestamps): `DiscordUserRes`, `DiscordGuildRes`, `DiscordChannelRes`, `DiscordEmojiRes`, `DiscordRoleRes`, `DiscordInteractionRes`, `DiscordMessageRes`, `DiscordAttachmentRes`, `DiscordMemberRes`.

sections.title: Guild-level settings ([`DiscordGuildSettings.cs`](DiscordGuildSettings.cs))
rows: Channel where the bot accepts commands (`null` = no channel restriction).
Channel where the bot posts errors and operational notices (`null` = disabled).
Role treated as server admin for bot permission checks.
Role treated as moderator for bot permission checks.
Monotonic config-binding revision; filled on read, cleared before write so it is never persisted.
When set, comic reading is limited to this channel.
Optional BCP-47 language filter for comic search and chapter lists.
When false (default), comic reading is rejected in NSFW channels.
sections.lead: `DiscordGuildSettings` is the document the config store persists under `EntityRef.For<DiscordGuild>(guildId)`. Versioned so older snapshots can be upgraded:
sections.trail:
`NormalizeForRead()` upgrades older snapshots in-place (e.g. v1 → v2 → v3). `NormalizeForPersistence()` calls `NormalizeForRead()` and stamps `Version = CurrentSchemaVersion`
before save.
